grid.grid-template-areas: "i n alert lock" "chips chips chips chips"

climate.order: [[[ return (() => { const s = states[variables.climate_entity]?.state; return s && s !== 'off' && s !== 'unavailable'; })() ? 0 : 1; ]]]

tv.display: [[[ const e = variables.tv_entity; const s = e && states[e] && states[e].state; return (s && !['off','unavailable','unknown','standby','idle'].includes(s)) ? 'flex' : 'none'; ]]]

projector.display: [[[ const e = variables.projector_entity; const s = e && states[e] && states[e].state; return (s && !['off','unavailable','unknown'].includes(s)) ? 'flex' : 'none'; ]]]

receiver.display: [[[ const e = variables.receiver_entity; const s = e && states[e] && states[e].state; return (s && !['off','unavailable','unknown','standby','idle'].includes(s)) ? 'flex' : 'none'; ]]]

card.entity: [[[ const b = window.charroLockBadge ? window.charroLockBadge(variables, states) : null; return b ? b.entity : ''; ]]]
card.icon: [[[ const b = window.charroLockBadge ? window.charroLockBadge(variables, states) : null; return b ? b.icon : 'mdi:lock'; ]]]

icon.color: [[[ const b = window.charroLockBadge ? window.charroLockBadge(variables, states) : null; return b ? b.fg : 'var(--disabled-text-color)'; ]]]
